title: Data+ V2 (New Version)
overview: CompTIA Data+ is an early-career data analytics certification that shows you have the practical skills to turn raw data into meaningful insights. Gain the confidence to analyze, interpret, and communicate data clearly, so you can solve real business problems, stand out to employers, and help your organization make smarter, data-driven decisions. Build a foundation in modern data concepts so you can confidently navigate analytics tools and data sources in any organization.
skills_measured: Review the official CompTIA exam blueprint for a detailed breakdown of skills measured.
prerequisites: Recommended experience: 18–24 months in a data analyst or similar job role, with exposure to databases, analytical tools, basic statistics, and data visualization
